modmenu.descriptionTranslation.fasttree: Chop the trees faster, faster, faster!
fasttree.config.title: Fast Tree Settings
fasttree.config.description: Chop the trees faster, faster, faster!
fasttree.group.felling.desc: Log limits, fast leaf decay and sapling replanting
fasttree.group.protection.desc: Build protection, roots, and drop collection
fasttree.group.axe.desc: Tool restrictions and break prevention rules
fasttree.group.durability.desc: Tool damage multiplier per log chopped
fasttree.group.gameplay.desc: Creative mode and food exhaustion multipliers
fasttree.config.enabled.desc: Enables or disables Fast Tree felling trees at once.
fasttree.config.max_logs.desc: Maximum number of logs that can be broken in a single tree.
fasttree.config.break_leaves.desc: Causes leaves to decay rapidly after chopping a tree instead of lingering.
fasttree.config.auto_replant.desc: Automatically plants a matching sapling where the lowest log was broken.
fasttree.config.leaf_protection.desc: Prevents destroying wooden buildings without leaves nearby.
fasttree.config.break_nether_warts.desc: Breaks wart blocks and shroomlights on huge nether fungi.
fasttree.config.break_mangrove_roots.des: Includes mangrove root blocks when felling mangrove trees.
fasttree.config.teleport_drops.desc: Sends drops directly to player inventory instead of dropping on the ground.
fasttree.config.require_axe.desc: Forces tree chopping to only work when holding an axe.
fasttree.config.prevent_tool_break.desc: Stops chopping when the axe has 1 durability left to save it from breaking.
fasttree.config.durability_multiplier.de: Durability damage applied to the tool per log broken (default: 1.0x).
fasttree.config.sneak_mode.desc: Controls how the Shift (Sneak) key affects tree chopping.
fasttree.config.sneak_mode.sneak_disable: Sneak to Disable (Single Block with Shift)
fasttree.config.break_in_creative.desc: Enables Fast Tree even when in Creative mode.
fasttree.config.hunger_multiplier.desc: Hunger exhaustion multiplier for chopping extra logs.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.fasttree: Chop the trees faster, faster, faster!
